note: Substrate §5.3 — the CHECKABLE form of the no-self-score rule. `The manifest carries no score and no self-assessment` (§5.1) cannot be enforced in general, but 'reject any unrecognized non-namespaced top-level field' can be, and it catches the obvious spellings: `score`, `confidence`, `rank`, `expectedPassRate`. A proposer cannot grade its own homework at the top level. What this does NOT catch is a score smuggled inside a namespaced extension — that is a consumer-MUST-IGNORE rule, stated in §5.3 and unenforceable here on purpose.
